title: Borrowing a Tool from a Neighbor
context: Maya 想挂一幅画，向邻居 Ethan 借工具。课程为 2026-11-22 预制系列，练习题并非官方真题。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Hi, Ethan. Do you have a hammer I could borrow?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，Ethan。我可以借用一下你的锤子吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: I think so. What are you working on?

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I want to hang a picture in my living room.

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Sure. Let me check the toolbox in my closet.
dialogue.zh: 当然可以。我去看看壁橱里的工具箱。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Thanks. I only need it for a few minutes.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我只需要用几分钟。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Here it is. Do you need any nails, too?
dialogue.zh: 找到了。你还需要钉子吗？

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Yes, please. I have some, but they're too long.
dialogue.zh: 需要，谢谢。我有一些，不过太长了。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: These small ones should work for a light picture.
dialogue.zh: 这些小钉子应该适合挂轻的画。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: Perfect. I'll bring the hammer back tonight.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我今晚把锤子还给你。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: No rush. You can leave it by my door.
dialogue.zh: 不着急。你可以把它放在我门边。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: I'll knock first, just in case you're home.
dialogue.zh: 我会先敲门，看看你是否在家。

dialogue.speaker: Ethan
dialogue.en: Sounds good. I hope the picture looks great!
dialogue.zh: 好啊。希望画挂起来很好看！

expressions.zh: 我能借用……吗？用 could 礼貌地提出借用请求。
expressions.example: Could I borrow your scissors for a minute?

expressions.zh: 你在忙什么？可询问对方正在做的事。
expressions.example: What are you working on this afternoon?

expressions.zh: 让我查一下。表示先确认再答复。
不着急。告诉对方不必马上做。
expressions.example: No rush. You can return the book tomorrow.

expressions.zh: 以防万一，引出想要预先考虑的情况。
expressions.example: Take a jacket just in case it gets cold.

pronunciation: 在 Could I borrow 中将 could 的尾音 /d/ 与 I 连读；在 no rush 中突出 rush 的 /ʌ/，不要读成长音 /uː/。

practice.title: Part 1 · Neighbors
practice.prompt: Do you know your neighbors well?
practice.answer: I know a few of them. We say hello in the hallway, and sometimes we help each other with small things.

practice.title: Part 2 · A useful object
practice.prompt: Describe an object you borrowed from someone. Say what it was, who lent it to you, and how you used it.
practice.answer: I once borrowed a ladder from my neighbor when I needed to reach a high shelf. Mine was too short, so I knocked on his door and explained the problem. He lent me his ladder for the afternoon and asked me to bring it back when I was done. I cleaned it and returned it that evening. It saved me a trip to the store, and I thanked him for helping me. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Sharing
practice.prompt: Why might neighbors share things instead of buying their own?
practice.answer: Some objects are only needed occasionally, so sharing can save space and money. It can also give neighbors a chance to get to know each other.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读对话，注意礼貌请求的语调；然后扮演 Maya，借一把剪刀并约定归还时间。
practice.answer: Could I borrow your scissors? I need them to open a box. I'll bring them back this evening.
